head: Arvidsson lights the lamp for a hat trick
paras: Connor Bedard opened the scoring for the Blackhawks early in the first, and they didn’t score again. Viktor Arvidsson made it 1-1 for Detroit early in the second. John Gibson stopped Frank Nazar on a penalty shot midway through the period. Lucas Raymond gave the Red Wings the lead on the power play early in the third, and Arvidsson struck again with four and a half minutes left to make it 3-1. Arvidsson completed his hat trick into the empty net with a little over three minutes left.

The score was fair. Replay this game’s chances a hundred times and the Red Wings win about seven in ten. Spencer Knight kept the Blackhawks in it, stopping 25 of 28. The Wings moved to 6-4-3, climbing off the bottom of the Atlantic, now seventh. The Blackhawks fell to 4-9-0, still last in the Central.

items.text: Patrick Kane played his first game back in Detroit.
The Blackhawks have lost five straight on the road.
NHL.com had projected the Red Wings with 11 forwards and seven defensemen, but they dressed 12 and six.
Justin Faulk faces his old team, St. Louis, on Saturday.
